result.instructions: Tools for Portkey, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Portkey data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run portkey_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run portkey_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run portkey_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. portkey_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: portkey_get_analytics_graph
tools.title: Get analytics graph
tools.description: Get a time-series analytics graph for a single metric (cost, requests, tokens, latency, error-rate, cache-hit-rate, …) over a time window. Optionally scope by virtual keys, configs, or metadata. Portkey: GET /analytics/graphs/{metric}.

time_of_generation_min.description: Start of the window (ISO8601, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM).

time_of_generation_max.description: End of the window (ISO8601, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM).

total_units.description: Bucket size for the series, e.g. "day" or "hour".

virtual_keys.description: Comma-separated virtual key slugs to scope the graph.

configs.description: Comma-separated config slugs to scope the graph.

metadata.description: JSON string of metadata key/values to scope the graph.

tools.name: portkey_get_analytics_group
tools.title: Get analytics group
tools.description: Get grouped analytics (aggregated by models, users, or metadata) over a time window. Portkey: GET /analytics/groups/{group}.

group.description: Dimension to group the analytics by.

time_of_generation_min.description: Start of the window (ISO8601, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM).

time_of_generation_max.description: End of the window (ISO8601, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM).

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default 50.

tools.name: portkey_list_configs
tools.title: List configs
tools.description: List gateway configs (routing/fallback/retry/cache rulesets applied to requests). Portkey: GET /configs.

workspace_id.description: Scope configs to a workspace id/slug.

tools.name: portkey_get_config
tools.title: Get config
tools.description: Get a single gateway config by slug (or id), including its routing rules. Portkey: GET /configs/{slug}.

tools.name: portkey_list_api_keys
tools.title: List API keys
tools.description: List API keys in the organization/workspace (metadata only — secrets are never returned). Portkey: GET /api-keys.

workspace_id.description: Scope keys to a workspace id/slug.

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default 50.

tools.name: portkey_get_api_key
tools.title: Get API key
tools.description: Get a single API key's metadata by id (the secret is never returned). Portkey: GET /api-keys/{id}.

tools.name: portkey_list_virtual_keys
tools.title: List virtual keys
tools.description: List virtual keys (the aliases that map to provider credentials + budget/rate limits used in requests). Portkey: GET /virtual-keys.

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default 50.

tools.name: portkey_get_virtual_key
tools.title: Get virtual key
tools.description: Get a single virtual key by slug, including its provider + limits. Portkey: GET /virtual-keys/{slug}.

tools.name: portkey_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces in the organization. Portkey: GET /workspaces.

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default 50.

tools.name: portkey_get_workspace
tools.title: Get workspace
tools.description: Get a single workspace by slug/id. Portkey: GET /workspaces/{id}.

tools.name: portkey_list_workspace_members
tools.title: List workspace members
tools.description: List members of a workspace (users + their roles). Portkey: GET /workspaces/{id}/members.

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default 50.

tools.name: portkey_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the organization. Filter by role or email. Portkey: GET /users.

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default 50.

role.description: Filter users by role (e.g. admin, member).

tools.name: portkey_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get a single user by id. Portkey: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: portkey_list_user_invites
tools.title: List user invites
tools.description: List pending user invitations to the organization. Portkey: GET /user-invites.

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default 50.

tools.name: portkey_list_audit_logs
tools.title: List audit logs
tools.description: List audit log entries (admin actions across the organization). Portkey: GET /audit-logs.

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default 50.

tools.name: portkey_create_feedback
tools.title: Create feedback
tools.description: WRITES a feedback record into the Portkey account, attached to a request/trace by trace_id. Use for logging a quality score (typically -10..10) with an optional weight (0..1) and metadata. Portkey: POST /feedback.

trace_id.description: The request/trace id to attach feedback to.
